summary: ### Requirements - [x] I have updated Smartcar to the latest available version. - [x] I read the [_Known Issues and Limitations_][known] section in the README and the [FAQ][faq]. BMW/Mini has turned off access to my vehicle data from 3rd parties. I want it back, as their app doesn't serve my needs. I'm in the US with a Mini 2 door SE ### Describe the solution you'd like I'd like a hacs integration that connects to BMW/Mini servers as a mobile device, so it can complete the connection with smartcar, and return the required auth to the hacs integration. ### Describe alternatives you've considered I asked claude to make me an android app that takes the smartcar auth through the Mini oauth process to the point smartcar says I'm connected, but the haos/hacs integration doesn't complete. ### Additional context _No response_
